title: Provisioning request and approval log
description: Per grant: requester, approver, role bundle, target, timestamp; reconciled to identity provider state.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Deprovisioning timeliness report
description: For each departure or role change, time from engagement end or change to access removal per system, with exceptions.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Recertification campaign record
description: Population snapshot with count reconciled to source, reviewer decisions, self-review blocks, suspensions and remediation.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Privileged elevation and session log
description: Every elevation request, approver, scope, duration and session activity, stored where the elevated principal cannot alter it.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Database grant declaration and drift report
description: Declared grants per role and Strata comparison with the live database before each deployment.
producer: Strata (pilot tool; exists, not operated for production)
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Break-glass activation record and tenant notices
description: Activation approvals, scope, duration, actions, security owner page, tenant notifications and post-use review.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Access transparency log
description: Customer-visible record of each operator access: who, when, scope, reason, case, delegation, records touched.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Secret scanning and credential age report
description: Secret scanning results per commit and age of any static credential in the secret store.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Workload identity inventory export
description: Generated list of workload identities with owner, permissions, credential type and last use.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Agent action records with delegation chain
description: Per agent action: agent principal, owner, delegating principal chain, policy version, authority tier, tools available, decision.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Emergency stop test and activation record
description: Results of periodic emergency stop tests and any real activations with queued-action disposition.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Customer administrator change and recovery log
description: Administrator grants, delegations, step-up events, second approvals and any recovery procedure with notices.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Identity lifecycle event log
description: Proofing outcomes (without raw documents), realm links, death or incapacity flags and verified suspensions, federation-exit enrollments.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)
